earlier.claim: kmctl summary ack cannot clear the summary when it already holds checked with today's date and the same ids. It rewrites identical bytes, so .okf/summary.md has no working-tree change, the commit-order rule still lists the summary, and ack still prints 'checked ... against ...' as if it had done something. Repro: init and commit; new decision X, ack, commit everything (clear); append a line to X and commit; review due lists summary (X); ack prints 'checked ... against X'; git status shows nothing; review due still lists summary (X), and kmctl check still warns. Editing the same concept twice in a day is common (the plan measures about 10 concept changes a day), and for the rest of that day the only way out is a hand edit to the body. That breaks r4's fails_when ('the summary stays listed after ... ack'). The r4 tests never ack twice against the same ids on the same day.

ROUTING always says 'Start at .okf/summary.md', even when the bundle has no summary.md. That happens in every project made before this change that moves its pin to this release (ADR 0026) and has not run kmctl update yet: the briefing sends the agent to a missing file at every session start, while the CLAUDE.md block still says .okf/index.md. render already knows whether a summary exists (summary_behind is None when there is none), so it can fall back to .okf/index.md.

User docs and the package's rule now contradict the change. docs/tutorials/get-started-with-kmctl.md step 2 gives kmctl init's output without the 'created .okf/summary.md' line it now prints, and says index.md is where a reader starts. apm/claude/.apm/instructions/okf-bundle.instructions.md and apm/antigravity/.apm/instructions/okf-bundle.instructions.md, which this repo ships, say '## Start at the root index'. README.md's 'Working on kmctl' says to start at .okf/index.md.

ADR 0027's Consequences says kmctl update in an older bundle 'writes summary.md and warns until .okf/index.md links it'. kmctl update warns once. After that, kmctl check fails with 'error index .okf/summary.md not listed in .okf/index.md' until the user adds the line, and that error also fails the kmctl-check pre-commit hook and CI. Say that the check fails (as it does for the manifesto), and add a line to commands.md's init/update section, so a person who upgrades knows the one manual step.

new.claim: When the kept .okf/log.md is not UTF-8 but the index is, init prints 'linked .okf/summary.md from .okf/index.md, with a line in .okf/log.md' and then a warning that it could not add the line to log.md. The two lines contradict each other. Drop the 'with a line in .okf/log.md' clause, or print it only when the log line was written.
